about_the_game:
Embark on a thrilling adventure with a diverse cast of characters in this engaging puzzle game! Join a determined student, a knowledgeable librarian, and a dedicated teacher as they guide you through a series of challenging puzzles and captivating stories. Each character brings their unique perspective to the game, making each level an exciting and immersive experience.

Features:

  • 100 Unique Levels: Every level presents a fresh challenge, with creative puzzles and intriguing narratives tied to the lives of a student, librarian, and teacher.

  • Increased Difficulty: As you progress, the puzzles become more complex and require more time and strategy to solve. The growing challenge keeps the gameplay engaging and rewarding.

  • Variety of Characters: Dive into the world of a student, librarian, and teacher, solving profession-based puzzles and uncovering their personal stories. Each character has their own special abilities and challenges, adding depth to the gameplay.

  • Captivating Gameplay: The difficulty ramps up as you advance, making each successful solution feel like a true accomplishment. You’ll be hooked by the puzzles and the compelling storylines.

  • Restoring Images: Enjoy the satisfaction of restoring beautiful, detailed images as part of your puzzle-solving journey. Each restored image provides a moment of peace and accomplishment.

  • Perfect for Relaxation: Take your time to immerse yourself in the game, unwinding and relaxing while you work through the puzzles and uncover the mysteries each level holds.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is intended exclusively for people over the age of 18. In addition, all the characters featured in this game have come of age.
This game features scenes of a sexual nature and nudity.
